newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gold rates seen steady on fresh demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gold rates seen steady on fresh demand.

text.p: KARACHI, Pakistan, July 28 (Reuer) - Pakistan's gold prices are likely to hold stable in the week amid fresh demand prompted by last week's sharp price fall, dealers said on Monday.
"Demand for gold jewellery will rise as gold prices have fallen sharply," dealer Sajid Siddiqi said, adding the rise in demand will give stability to gold prices.
He said silver prices are also likely to rise if gold demand improved.
